name: Moonlit Bookshop
image_style: Painterly digital illustration with softly textured gouache and vintage lithograph grain, blending lunar surrealism with cozy old-world bookseller warmth. Use layered atmospheric depth, delicate brushwork, muted umbers and tobacco browns against deep blue-black lunar shadows, with dusty silver moonlight, aged parchment highlights, and restrained amber accents. The mood is quiet, mysterious, nostalgic, and contemplative, with cinematic wide composition, gentle rim lighting, and ample uncluttered negative space along the top edge. Landscape wallpaper art, no lettering or typography.
scene: A wide moonlit panorama of an old bookshop built into a crater on the lunar surface, its crooked wooden storefront and glowing amber windows nestled among pale rocks and drifting dust. Space Ghost stands quietly in the foreground near the entrance, his white hooded figure illuminated by cool moonlight, one hand resting on a weathered stack of books. Inside, towering shelves, ladders, globes, and floating pages create a warm, dreamlike interior. Earth hangs small and distant near the horizon, while the upper portion remains calm and sparsely detailed with soft indigo sky and faint stars. No lettering.
source_phrase: An old bookshop on the moon
